description: Commission of Election - Notify under local Authorities Elections Ordinance to nominate Thangaraj Kisokumar as Vice Chairman of the Norwood P/S
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for the office of Vice Chairman in a local government body (Norwood Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content specifically deals with an electoral process at the local government level, including the nomination and declaration of an elected official, which falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" classification (Type 7).
